title: Finance/Legal Personal To-dos — Olivia Martinez
content:
Quick scratchpad (personal) — for daily triage + follow-ups

2026-02-14 — morning check
- Inbox cleanup: prioritized finance/legal items only

INVOICES TO CHECK / ACTION
1) Vendor: DataStream Inc. — INV-2026-0212 ($18,450)
   - Due: 2026-02-20. Status: Received, needs 2nd approver (Diego).
   - TODO: Add PO# 7892 to invoice copy (AP policy). Ping Diego in Slack.
   - Linked: FIN-342 (invoice workflow)

2) Contractor: Upwork — Feb payout ($3,120)
   - Due: 2026-02-16. Status: waiting on correct expense code from PM (Sarah).
   - Quick note: remind PM to submit expense codes by EOD 2026-02-14.

3) Azure overage credit request (invoice AZ-2026-01)
   - Need supporting usage logs (infra team). Slack infra-ops.
   - If no response by 2026-02-17 escalate to SRE manager.

CONTRACTS / REDLINES (high priority)
- Redwood <> Nimbus Labs — SOW v3_redline.docx
  - Deadline for counterparty review: 2026-02-21
  - Key items to push: liability cap stays at $2M (they want $5M), data residency clause (we accept EU-only for this customer), and indemnities — keep as is.
  - Action: prepare a short cover email explaining rationale for caps and data residency. Ask Legal (Maya) for final language by 2026-02-16.

- Template: reseller_agreement_template (needs update)
  - Problem: payment terms section ambiguous (net30 vs net45). Ops prefers net45 for partners in APAC.
  - TODO: draft alternate clause and flag for PG review. Put on Confluence page for comments.

- Customer: BrightBank — Master Services Agreement (redline ongoing)
  - They proposed broader audit rights. Counterproposal: limited to once per 12 months with notice and scoped to logs only.
  - Action: add counterlanguage and circulate to legal-team@redwood for quick review.

RENEWALS / REMINDERS
- SSO provider (AuthCo) — annual renewal 2026-03-05
  - Auto-renew? No. Check current spend + usage. If we keep, need PO and new budget line.
  - TODO: ask IT to provide last 90-day login metrics by 2026-02-20.

- Insurance broker retainer — renew 2026-04-01
  - Note: get updated quote from broker by 2026-03-01. Add to Q2 budget review.

QUICK NOTES / FLAGS
- Make short checklist email for Sales to attach to contracts when they request exceptions. (Template: sales-exception-checklist)
- Reminder: include clause about model output data for Dedicated/Private customers (data-in-scope vs telemetry). Need product input. @Product: get one-paragraph summary.
- Open question: escalate vendor with repeated late invoices to procurement? Discuss with finance manager.

MEETINGS / NEXT STEPS
- 2026-02-15 10:00 AM — Contract triage with Maya + Diego (30m). Prep: bring SOW v3 and BrightBank redline.
- 2026-02-16 3:00 PM — Budget sync with Finance Ops (approve vendor payments).
- Week of 2026-02-22 — finalize reseller template and publish to Confluence

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep this doc lightweight; transfer finalized items to Confluence (Contracts page) and Jira (FIN/LEGAL tickets).
- When closing invoice tasks, add comment with approver name + timestamp. Helps AP audits.

Unresolved questions:
- Do we accept Nimbus Labs request for EU-only hosting for this SOW? (Depends on Dedicated capacity availability; check infra availability)
- Is there precedent for dealer/reseller net45? Check FY24 reseller deals (Confluence link above).

End of scratchpad.

(Added quick links: Confluence page, FIN-342 ticket, LEGAL-78).
